# Strike-through styling matches each todo's state after the list redraws

## Add two todos and complete one
Open http://localhost:4173/. Add a todo "Buy milk", then add a todo "Walk the dog". Tick the checkbox next to "Buy milk". Verify the footer counter reads exactly "1 item left".

## Add a third todo
Add a todo "Pay rent". Verify exactly three todos are listed: "Buy milk", "Walk the dog" and "Pay rent", and the footer counter reads exactly "2 items left".

## Check each row's styling
Without clicking anything, look at the todo list on the current page. Verify "Buy milk" has its checkbox ticked and its text is struck through (greyed out), and verify "Walk the dog" and "Pay rent" both have unticked checkboxes and their text is NOT struck through (normal dark text).

## Reload and check again
Reload the page. Verify "Buy milk" is still the only todo whose text is struck through, and "Walk the dog" and "Pay rent" are shown as normal text with no strike-through.
